proposedManifest.sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
proposedManifest.description: Sam Wilson carries Steve Rogers' shield into a country divided over whether it belongs to him. Then Steve puts the uniform back on, and there are two Captain Americas. From Pleasant Hill through Civil War II, the two men wear the same star while making very different choices about whom it should protect.
